interpretation: Exploratory follow-up designed after core source and target performance was known.

interval.method: Unbounded normal interval from a first-order delta expansion of the accepted-count inverse.
interval.assumptions: Independent binomial pseudo-data acceptance and source-response class counts, fixed checkpoints and strict numerical cuts.
interval.scope: Includes finite pseudo-data and source-response precision. Threshold-selection and retraining uncertainty are outside the interval. Generator differences are assessed through empirical bias and coverage.

source_coverage_control.population: TASK-0006 source pseudo-data population, with 5000 rows per class.
source_coverage_control.response_per_replicate: Draw 5000 quarks and 5000 gluons independently with replacement from this same empirical class law. These are simulated repeated measurements, distinct from the actual disjoint pools.
source_coverage_control.pseudo_data_per_replicate: Draw an IID mixture from the same class law, independently of the simulated response measurement. Reuse the original six cells and 1000 replicates per cell.
source_coverage_control.gate: Require every checkpoint/cell coverage to lie within five binomial MCSE of 0.95 before opening target score arrays. This is an implementation diagnostic across the declared grid.

fixed_response_modes.pythia: Reuse the TASK-0006 accepted counts and fixed original response measurements. Coverage is conditional on those finite pools.
fixed_response_modes.herwig: Draw mixtures from the saved Herwig score archive using the same original Pythia response measurements. Coverage is conditional on those finite pools.

bias_comparison.point: Use the exact conditional expectation under the observed class pools, eliminating Monte Carlo integration noise in expected bias.
bias_comparison.aggregation: Absolute bias per seed, then arithmetic mean. Keep seed ranges. Negative PID-minus-kinematics contrast favours PID.
bias_comparison.bias_sample_size_dependence: Expected bias at fixed response is independent of pseudo-data N. Report its contrast once per fraction. RMSE and interval coverage retain both sample sizes.
bias_comparison.bootstrap: Class-stratified row bootstrap of the actual source response and complete Herwig class pools. Reuse row indices across model/seed columns within each class. Source and target draws are independent. Descriptive percentile intervals at fixed cuts and checkpoints.

stages: source freezes protocol and implementation, saves coverage controls and original-pool interval diagnostics, then records source_validated. target verifies that state and all frozen hashes before opening target scores.
efn: Standby pending completion of the mixture expansion and the user's subsequent decision.
